name: Prototype Pollution
attack_scenario: user-controlled keys reach Object prototype (via __proto__/constructor.prototype or a recursive merge of untrusted data), polluting every object and enabling privilege escalation, DoS, or RCE
negative_test_hint: merge {"__proto__":{"isAdmin":true}} and assert ({}).isAdmin is still undefined

exemplar.compliant:
if (key === "__proto__" || key === "constructor" || key === "prototype") return;
target[key] = value;   // or use a Map / Object.create(null)
exemplar.explanation: reject __proto__/constructor/prototype keys, or store data in a Map / null-prototype object
